name: 65109 · Jefferson Cty, MO
findings: ZIP 65109 (Jefferson Cty) has 280 nonprofit organizations. 153 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 138 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 65109 (Jefferson Cty) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
